question: Can accession-matched GSM2462968 RNA be quantified on the exact 84 target set?
decision: Recover one experiment 1 library on a comparable transcript reference before within-experiment estimation.
strongest_rival: Unknown donor or pool nesting and culture-associated selection could account for bulk abundance differences. Cargo RNA can also contribute to challenged samples.
discriminator: Check accession roles and reference coverage, preserve separate experiments, and screen challenge data against cargo-only RNA.
exposure_record: Publication and experiment 2 and challenge TPM outcomes known. Experiment 1 raw TPM outcomes unopened when specified.
biological_unit: Independent withdrawal experiment or single cargo challenge experiment. Donor and preparation nesting unknown.
nesting_and_overlap: Two culture libraries per withdrawal contrast. Fig. 3G duplicates are technical; overlap of withdrawal libraries with the challenge is unverified.
population_and_selection: WT Tim-4-positive mouse peritoneal macrophages and irradiated thymocytes as the cargo RNA control.
contrast: Single-library quantification of GSM2462968 using its accession-matched ENA reads.
endpoint: Transcript TPM and estimated counts, with trimming and pseudoalignment summaries.
methods: Trim with cutadapt 4.9 using -m 35 -q 30,30. Index verified Ensembl 84 cDNA with Kallisto 0.43.1 k31 and quantify with --single -l 200 -s 30 --plaintext and no bootstraps.
missingness_and_exclusions: Trim short or low-quality reads under the GEO settings. Report trimming and pseudoalignment metrics.
multiplicity: Fixed paper-derived panels, fully reported without significance tests.
precision_basis: Two experiments for comparison of directions and only technical duplication for challenge. No animal-level precision estimate.
interpretation_limit: A new quantification using the identified reference, deposited reads and stated version adaptations. No original experiment 1 TPMs are recovered.
stop_rule: Hold if accession join, ENA checksum, reference integrity or the quantification fails.
amendment_reason: Initial descriptive replay of the verified revised plan using the deposited TPM scale.
